title.tr: Platformlu merdiven üstten, yanda tel çit ve pencere
title.en: Stairs with a platform from above, wire fencing and a window

alt.tr: Üstten bakışla platformlu ahşap merdiven ve çaprazlı korkuluk; yanda tel çit ve evin penceresi
alt.en: Top view of timber stairs with a platform and cross-braced railing, with wire fencing and the house window beside

caption.tr: Platform ile basamaklar birbirine bağlanıyor, altı koyu bir tahtayla kapatılmış. Evin penceresi hemen yanında.
caption.en: The platform and steps are joined together, with the underside closed off by a dark board. The house window is right beside.
